description_one_sentence: One row per registered customer, with contact details, address, birth date and loyalty tier.
issues_spotted: 8 duplicate customer_id + 61 case-insensitive duplicate emails (uniqueness); country stored in 18 spellings e.g. FR/France/fr/france/FRA, DE/DEU/Allemagne/Germany (consistency); phone format inconsistent: '+33 6 28 32 68 42', '06.32.83.38.98', '+34666395517', '0033673792749' (consistency); 48 missing emails, 30 missing phones, 37 missing countries (completeness); loyalty_tier has casing/typo variants GOLD/Gold/Platinium (consistency)

description_one_sentence: The catalogue of products ShopFast sells, with price, category, supplier and active status.
issues_spotted: 1 product with a missing unit_price_eur and 2 with a price <= 0 (completeness/accuracy); category has casing variants e.g. 'electronics' vs 'Electronics', 'SPORTS' vs 'Sports' (consistency)

description_one_sentence: One row per customer order, with order date, status, sales channel, shipping country and total amount paid.
issues_spotted: 7 duplicate order_id (uniqueness); status has casing/spelling variants e.g. SHIPPED/Delivered vs shipped/delivered and 'canceled' vs 'cancelled' (consistency); 14 orders reference a customer_id absent from customers (referential integrity); 11 missing order_date and some total_amount_eur are negative e.g. -49.90 (completeness/accuracy); re-classified Y not N: customer_id is a reversible pseudonym, so per GDPR this table is still personal data even with no name/email stored

description_one_sentence: One row per product line within an order, with quantity and the unit price charged.
issues_spotted: 4 rows reference a product_id absent from products (referential integrity); 8 rows have quantity <= 0 (validity); 165 rows where unit_price_eur differs from the product's current catalogue price (accuracy / price drift, not reconciled against product price history); no customer_id here but still joinable to a customer via order_id -> orders.customer_id

description_one_sentence: One row per payment attempt for an order, with method, amount, currency and status.
issues_spotted: card_last4 is missing for 1,059 of 2,539 card payments but present for 1,469 non-card payments (apple_pay/paypal/bank_transfer) - the field looks mis-populated, which defeats the masking it is meant to provide (consistency/accuracy); 5 orders where the captured-payment total does not match orders.total_amount_eur, including 2 with a negative order total (accuracy); no customer_id directly, but joinable to a customer via order_id -> orders.customer_id, so treat as indirectly personal

description_one_sentence: One row per customer-service ticket, with the customer's free-text message and the agent's free-text notes.
issues_spotted: re-classified Confidential -> Restricted: ~95 tickets leak unmasked PII inside free-text message/agent_notes, including full card numbers (ticket 30007: 'My card 5132 7893 2879 2179...') and birth dates ('Customer born 1949-05-28, verified identity.') - one such column makes the whole table Restricted, per the 'most sensitive column' rule; 150 tickets have empty agent_notes (likely normal for simple/unresolved tickets, low severity)

description_one_sentence: A one-off extract of customer contact info and loyalty tier, built by Marketing for the spring 2026 campaign.
data_custodian: Marketing Ops (ad hoc export, no engineering pipeline)
refresh_frequency: Ad hoc (one-off per campaign, not scheduled)
issues_spotted: ungoverned shadow copy: an ad hoc export of customer PII (email, first_name) with no defined custodian, pipeline or retention/deletion date, sitting outside the governed customers table; stale vs source: 8 rows have a loyalty_tier and 29 rows an email that no longer match the current customers table, with no lineage back to the source to detect this; all 600 rows do have marketing_consent = true in customers today, but nothing re-checks this before each send
